# Booha World

> Booha World is the public website for Booha Adventure (ブーハー・アドベンチャー) and the related projects of Bryan Harper, a native English teacher who runs Bryan's English School (ブライアン英会話教室) in Tomisato, Chiba, Japan. Booha Adventure is a private, PIN-access English learning web app (PWA) that Bryan Harper built for his school's students. It has no ads, no recommendation feed and no generative AI.

Key facts:

- Booha Adventure is an installable web app (PWA), not an App Store app. Students sign in with a name and PIN; access is included with lessons, and other schools can license PINs.
- Three curriculum tracks share 15 vocabulary words, 15 sentences and 15 questions each week: Pre-Boo (about EIKEN 5–4), Boo-riculum (about EIKEN 3–2) and Boo-Continuum (about EIKEN Pre-1–1).
- Weeks run Sunday to Saturday, Tokyo time. Each week has a Daily Check (about 5 minutes), nine Maze games, three timed Blitz rounds (an optional warm-up), two extra practice games and a Week Boss.
- Five explorable worlds: Karasuki, Utsuroba, Muenba, Grimmerglen and Akiya. The last four open each week once all nine Maze games are done.
- Rewards include rainbow stars for prepared students, weekly medals, permanent tokens, weekly postcards, an arcade, and Karasuki Cards (in-app collectible cards won through a word-memory challenge).
- The same weekly content serves two classes: the flipped Output Class and the 90-minute English Juku class.
- Not related to Booba, the animated character. Booha Cards is a separate physical card game series by the same author.
- Pages are bilingual (Japanese and English). Original content, characters, artwork and software are © Bryan Harper.

- [Booha Adventure overview](https://booha-adventure-studios.github.io/booha-world/adventure.html): what students and families need to know, access and PIN licensing
